Phase-12.NAME: Dogfooding
Phase-12.purpose: Validate MAGRA comfort and reliability through real pet-project development workflows before beta readiness is claimed.

steps.step-1: Create dogfooding report template with exact scenario, command, outcome, and friction sections.
steps.step-2: Run a small Node CLI pet-project scenario through MAGRA web chat and CLI.
steps.step-3: Run a small React/Vite pet-project scenario through MAGRA web chat and CLI.
steps.step-4: Run a docs/tooling project scenario focused on MyGRACE planning, reviewer, and release checks.
steps.step-5: Verify SNARC recall across restart, RTK shell behavior, MyGRACE slash flows, and dashboard SNARC endpoints.
steps.step-6: Summarize beta readiness, blocker list, and follow-up backlog in the dogfooding report.
